speechOptions.instruction: Read it flat and unhurried, like a good product keynote — the lines are already the argument, so do not perform them. Short declarative sentences, no exclamation, no salesy energy. Let the pauses between sentences breathe. The one place to slow down slightly is 'Amber is waiting on you.'

title: MulmoTerminal — The day you became the bottleneck (v7)
description: v7. Built from the 2-minute launch-video script of 2026-08-16 (ten shots, WHY first). Shots 0:00 / 0:08 / 1:28 / 1:44 are html_tailwind mocks until they are shot; the amber turn, the colour grid, the enlarge-and-answer, the roster, the worktree-diff-PR and the mixed grid are cut from existing footage. See mulmoterminal-120s-v7-NOTES.md.
